Engagement loops are failing; almost all videos lack comments, suggesting that current calls-to-action or ending questions are ineffective.
Several high-retention Shorts (over 100% average view percentage) suffer from low initial reach, implying that title and thumbnail packaging needs stronger click-through appeal.
Data for ultra-recent uploads (under 5 days old) is currently too thin to draw definitive long-term performance conclusions.
